mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schedule ( pet_seq, title, schedule_time, memo, status, notify_enabled ) VALUES ( #{petSeq}, #{title}, #{scheduleTime}, #{memo}, 'PLANNED', #{notifyEnabled} )
mapper.select: SELECT s.schedule_seq, s.pet_seq, s.title, s.schedule_time, s.memo, s.status, s.created_at, s.updated_at FROM schedule s JOIN pet p ON p.pet_seq = s.pet_seq WHERE p.user_seq = #{userSeq} ORDER BY s.schedule_time ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schedule s JOIN pet p ON p.pet_seq = s.pet_seq WHERE p.user_seq = #{userSeq}
